title: Hunts FH-037: Project paid ticket and order authority

source.ref: Frequency Hunts Build Plan (9 Nov 2026), Tier 4, Entitlement. Owner asked 2026-11-09 to build the program into the site.

detail: Consume canonical paid source and reconcile via durable intent and one seat-benefit key. Protect guest claim. Done when: Webhook and return race activate one benefit. Crash after paid state and delayed checkout converge. Requires: FH-009, FH-036. Owner role: Billing and database.
